reason: Drafted specification v001: users can change any task's status (To do / In progress / Done) from an accessible, keyboard-operable control on each task. The list, status filter and results count update immediately. One material question remains (Q1): should status changes persist across reloads like stars do? The draft assumes yes, and AC6–AC7 depend on the answer. Q2 (whether a task disappears straight away when it no longer matches the active filter) is not material and has a proposed default.
